technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with overbought oscillators and short-term bullish confluence, but price remains below intermediate moving averages and cloud resistance, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: ADSK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 57 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signal from junior member with small positions; market fear (40 score) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data and conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (400.0) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severely adverse macro conditions; earnings in 57 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Momentum confluence (AO cross-up, OBV rising, Supertrend bullish) with price near support (219.49) offers technical entry point in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, price below both 50-day moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, zero fundamental catalysts, extreme VIX crisis regime, and imminent earnings binary risk create overwhelming headwinds that negate technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum signals (AO cross-up, OBV rising, Supertrend bullish) present at support level, but fundamental vacuum, overbought oscillators, and macro crisis regime eliminate conviction for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (400.0) combined with earnings binary risk in 57 days and price rejection below both 50-day moving averages creates asymmetric downside in adverse macro environment.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents bullish but overwhelmed by fundamental weakness, sentiment void, and macro crisis consensus
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ADSK with 82 existing IT positions (16% of portfolio) creates concentration drag; skip entry to reduce sector overlap and preserve capital in crisis VIX regime.
